mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity risk premiums through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 110 and unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, strong supply conditions without labor market tightness drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economy without labor market tightness
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening without inflationary pressure (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL < 210), stable growth expectations drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL < 210, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales exceeding 370,000 million dollars signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 370000, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1400 thousand units and residential sales exceed 370,000 million dollars, robust housing market conditions drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 205 indicates moderate inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as markets price stable inflation without policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 205, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
